import numpy as np
B=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(x),x,v,x**2,x*v,v**2,x**3,v**3])
def fit(extra):
    A=np.column_stack([B]+extra)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((A@c-dv_dt)**2)/np.var(dv_dt), c
print("1/t",fit([1/t])[0])
print("1/t,1/t2",fit([1/t,1/t**2])[0])
print("1/t2,1/t3",fit([1/t**2,1/t**3])[0])
print("exp(-t^2)",fit([np.exp(-t**2)])[0])
print("exp(-t)",fit([np.exp(-t)])[0])
print("exp(-t),exp(-2t)",fit([np.exp(-t),np.exp(-2*t)])[0])
print("log t",fit([np.log(t)])[0])
